units.text: INT. RIVERBOAT CASINO COURTROOM - DAY
A gambling hall converted into a temporary courtroom after the flood.
Slot machines are draped in canvas, and brown water stains climb the walls.
A judge's bench has been built from a roulette table.
CLEMENTINE ASHWORTH, the defense attorney, stands at a card table with her hands folded.
She is sharp, silver-haired, and never hurried.
Across from her, MAXWELL DRUMM, the prosecutor, flips through a damp stack of papers.
He is young and eager, and his collar is two sizes too big.
At the roulette bench, JUDGE ISADORA FENWICK adjusts her glasses and glares down at both of them.
Near the door, BAILIFF NORBERT KWASNIEWSKI shifts his weight, his hand resting on a holstered flashlight.
Mr. Drumm. You were saying.
units.name: JUDGE FENWICK

units.text: He clears his throat and rises, dropping a page.
He stoops, recovers it, and comes up red.
Your Honor, the State maintains the defendant knowingly opened the sluice gates.
units.name: MAXWELL

units.text: Objection. He has not yet shown a single witness who saw her touch them.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Sustained. Move along.
units.name: JUDGE FENWICK

units.text: Maxwell glances at his notes, then at the bailiff, who gives him nothing.
He swallows.
Then I call the night watchman.
units.name: MAXWELL

units.text: Norbert opens the door.
No one is there.
He steps out, comes back, and shrugs.
He ain't come, ma'am.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: Of course he hasn't.
units.name: JUDGE FENWICK

units.text: Clementine rises slowly, smoothing her skirt.
She walks to the center of the room and lets the silence stand.
Your Honor, the State's case is built on a man who is not here, a gate no one saw opened, and a river that has a long habit of rising.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Maxwell opens his mouth, and she raises a hand.
He closes it.
I move to dismiss.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: The judge studies her over her glasses, then looks at the stained ceiling, the draped slots, the roulette wheel under her palm.
She spins it.
It clatters and settles.
Red seventeen.
units.name: JUDGE FENWICK

units.text: She lifts the gavel.
Dismissed.
units.name: JUDGE FENWICK
